notes: Top 100 institutions per provider (QS 2027, THE 2027, ARWU 2026): 300 entries, world ranks only. rank_display is reproduced exactly as published ('=8' = tied at 8th; a band such as '101-150' would be kept verbatim, never converted to a single number). No combined or averaged rank across providers is stored or computed anywhere (spec BR15). Rankings never affect eligibility (spec BR16). All rank values were re-verified from each provider's official source on 2026-11-25; anything not re-verified is recorded as unavailable, never filled from a third-party reproduction. Institution pages carry an IELTS reference transcribed from the user-supplied THE 2027 ranking-table images; it is a compiled reference only, is labelled as such in all locales, and is never used by the eligibility engine — programme matching uses only official programme pages.
